body.name: priorityH
body.def: After refreshing the agenda with \(\operatorname{Comp}_H\), \(\mathfrak P_H\) selects, in order: an actually present selector-correction token; the nonancestor sum-elimination token; the proper-district elimination token; the canonically least reachable-fixing token; or the sole residual token. Within a case it uses the order from \(\operatorname{enc}_H\). No unnamed transition or unsupplied context is eligible.
